summary: Iteration 28: client email + send PDF report, weekly digest (settings/preview/cron), client deadline reminders. New suite tests/test_email_digest_client_mail.py: 8/8 passed. It covers client email validation and clearing it (which sets notify_client to false), notify_client without a client (400), report send to a reserved domain (400 'Indirizzo non consentito per l'invio.' and email_log entry skipped_reserved_domain, last_report_sent not set), other user 404, anonymous 401, message over 1500 chars 422, 429 once 20 sends a day are reached, settings default false plus PUT/GET persistence, preview 400 + email_log entry + 429 after 5 a day, cron 401 x3 / 200 / duplicate:true on the same X-Webhook-Id / one digest per ISO week (last_digest_week) / only opted-in users get it / list body 400, crons.yml structure, digest_html sections and escaping, and _check_reminders on backend restart (exactly one client_reminder skipped_reserved_domain for the confirmed + notify_client deadline; none for notify_client=false or to_verify auto; sent_client not updated). Regression run of the 4 existing suites + the new one: 56 passed, 3 skipped (real AI) after a test-only fix. UI (desktop 1920 + mobile 390): all requested flows pass, no horizontal overflow. No real email attempts by me: main agent already used the single nunberne@gmail.com attempt (email_log status=failed, Resend 'docuanalytics.it domain is not verified'). Zero AI calls.

minor.issue: Changing due_date resets 'sent' but not 'sent_client', so a client who was already reminded for offset N won't be reminded again for the new date. Reset sent_client too.

No explicit status=='confirmed' guard. It only works because auto/to_verify deadlines keep notify_days=[] (prefs go in notify_pref). Add `if (r.get('status') or 'confirmed') != 'confirmed': continue` as a safeguard.
The error message is picked from the most recent client_report email_log row, which can race with parallel sends. Have send_email return its status instead of a bool.
last_digest_week is locked before sending, so a failed send (e.g. Resend domain not verified) is never retried that week. Acceptable, but worth noting.

issues: client-report-send-error stays visible after the form is closed with Annulla (err is not cleared on cancel/open).
'· anche al cliente' is shown even when the linked client has no email, so nothing will actually be sent to the client.
